spec.semantic_summary: Use target-visible signed parity branches to derive packed row bytes, then compare word-indexed versus byte-indexed row transfer forms.
binding_evidence: Disassembly explicitly divides source width by two, tests the remainder, and emits a distinct odd/even formula.
Target row copy has both REP MOVSW and REP MOVSB; test direct typed-word and byte-loop source forms.

axes.name: signed_packed_width_formula
axes.rationale: Target performs an IDIV-by-two parity test and separate signed row-byte formulas; alternatives preserve its positive-width ceil-by-two meaning.
values: if ((sourceWidth % 2) == 0) copyBytes = (sourceWidth + 1) / 2; else copyBytes = (sourceWidth - 1) / 2 + 1; copyBytes -= clipX / 2;

axes.name: row_transfer_loop
axes.rationale: Target splits byte count into a word REP copy and an odd-byte REP tail; compare typed-word and byte-pointer loop idioms under ordinary optimization.
values: for (col = 0; col < copyBytes; col++) destination[col] = source[col];
